header:
Missiles hit Riyadh
Oil barely blinked

lines.text: Missiles hit Saudi Arabia's capital. Oil barely blinked.
lines.say: Missiles hit Saudi Arabia's capital. Oil barely blinked.

lines.text: On Oct 10, a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's main airport killed at least 12 people and wounded 300+.
lines.say: On Saturday, a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's main airport killed at least twelve people and wounded over three hundred.

lines.text: Overnight, Brent crude jumped as high as $105.63, then slipped to $103.91 (Bloomberg).
lines.say: Overnight, Brent crude jumped to about a hundred six dollars, then slipped to about a hundred four.

lines.text: Why so calm? The strikes hit an airport, not oil sites. No Saudi exports were reported lost.
lines.say: Why so calm? The strikes hit an airport, not oil sites, and no Saudi exports were reported lost.

lines.text: But oil was already high: Brent averaged about $114 in September vs about $71 in February (EIA).
lines.say: But oil was already high. Brent averaged about a hundred fourteen dollars in September, versus about seventy-one in February.

lines.text: That price flows into gas pumps, plane tickets and shipping costs.
lines.say: That price flows into gas pumps, plane tickets and shipping costs.

lines.text: It's Columbus Day: the bond market is closed, stocks are open. Banks report from Tuesday, CPI on Wednesday.
lines.say: The bond market's closed for Columbus Day, but stocks are open. Big banks report starting Tuesday, and inflation data lands Wednesday.

lines.text: The takeaway: oil traders react to lost barrels, not scary headlines.
lines.say: The takeaway: oil traders react to lost barrels, not scary headlines.
